title: rs_evaluator_result_response
description: Structured output for a readiness-score scoring evaluator (rubric or coverage). Use this to submit your assessment of the work plan.

evaluator.description: The evaluator id producing this result.

score.description: This evaluator's own metric mapped to 0-100. Higher = more confidence the plan is accurate/complete for the spec.

pros.description: Exactly 3 strengths. Each <=140 chars, concrete, tied to the actual spec/plan (quote a requirement or a plan step).

cons.description: Exactly 3 weaknesses. Each <=140 chars and concrete. If fewer than 3 material cons exist, fill remaining slots with genuine nitpicks prefixed '(minor)' — never fabricate a material issue to hit the count.

rationale.description: One sentence on what drove the score. For coverage, include precision/recall counts here.
examples: recall 6/7, precision 5/6; one requirement (rate limiting) uncovered.
